panel.title: Demo tools
panel.description: These controls exist only in the prototype. They are not part of the product UI.

clock.title: Simulated clock
clock.noTarget: That submission has no date for this yet.

role.title: Identity
role.creator: You (creator)
role.note: Switching identity is a demo tool. The engine still checks permissions, and that check is simulated, not production authorisation.

outage.title: Data outage
outage.description: While this is on, new reads fail and the last trusted value is kept.

payout.title: Payout outcome
payout.description: Set the simulated provider result for an attempt that is processing or unknown.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.description: Loading a scenario rebuilds every demo record from the baseline. Anything you changed is discarded.

toolbar.engineMissing: The demo engine is not available in this build, so demo tools cannot change anything.
